_readme: USD per 1M tokens. Anthropic first-party Claude API prices checked 2026-11-13: claude-haiku-5-5 $0.10/$0.50 up to 100,000 prompt tokens, $0.50/$2.50 above (tier enforced in llm/anthropic.ts); claude-sonnet-5-5 $2/$10. Other entries are Nebius Token Factory models unless noted. Nebius Token Factory list prices (Base flavor, USD per 1M tokens, input / cached input / output) confirmed by Sunny on 16 Nov 2026 (decision 076q item 1): nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL 0.30/0.06/0.90, nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b 0.30/0.06/0.90, nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b 1.00/0.12/3.00, nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 0.06/0.012/0.24, Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 0.20/0.05/0.60 (listed as Deprecated). The client charges every input token at the input rate: cached input is not priced separately (the Nebius path does not read a cached-token count), so the ledger can only over-state cached input. Earlier the Nano and Super rates came from third-party trackers (OpenRouter, Bifrost, DeepInfra, Sep 2026); they equal the listed rates. Entries with "placeholder": true are NOT real prices; until filled, the budget uses placeholderFallback, a deliberately high estimate, so guardrails err toward refusing. nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL: the Nebius blog of 16 Oct 2026, "three new open-weight models from US companies", and the Token Factory model page (same rates as nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b). nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b (lowercase) is the free NVIDIA API (build.nvidia.com, decision 071), not Token Factory: 0 / 0, honoured only on the NVIDIA route (TRACEHOUND_NVIDIA_API=1), where its calls are ledgered at $0 with their real token counts; without that flag the client prices the id at placeholderFallback; the Token Factory id nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b (capital N) is a different entry, priced at the listed 1.00/3.00.
